scorecard.rationale: The KIM trial phases encouraged unspecified olive oil and its insomnia event concerned an overall diet. A cannabis series recorded a within-dose insomnia change with shared ungraded olive oil. AU-ARROW plans the Insomnia Severity Index within a multidomain program using extra-virgin oil. A Parkinson insomnia effect specific to the oil remains open. The gut-brain review mentions insomnia clinically and olive oil within a Mediterranean pattern. There is no separate Parkinson insomnia result by extra-virgin olive oil intake.
